ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels to 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pixel regions located on the distal halves of both lobes. Left lobe contains radial white streaks extending from center toward the trailing edge. Right lobe features a large, solid white geometric block containing several interior low-intensity circular voids. The central region around the notch is predominantly low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 110 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with non-uniform frequency and pixel-amplitude; serrations are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes with peak-to-valley variations ranging from 5 to 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward concave sweep trajectory fitted to the continuous linear boundary from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity, textured pixel groups at the extreme distal tips (barnacle colonies); multiple isolated circular 'eye-type' scars consisting of white outer rings and dark centers distributed across the pigmented regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions; notably a series of parallel diagonal marks on the mid-right lobe and isolated horizontal streaks near the central fluke junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization on distal tips; numerous circular scars consistent with previous ectoparasitic attachment sites are visible across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'target' circular markings (dark centers surrounded by high-intensity white rings) occurring as isolated focal points within larger pigmented zones on both lobes.
